summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return for Hong Kong listing rules. The filing details multiple share repurchases on the open market from May 27 through June 17, 2026, all for cancellation, at prices from approximately USD 6.67 to USD 7.25 per share. No stated premium, board recommendation, or advisor. The repurchases are ongoing capital-return actions reducing outstanding share count. Watch for continued buyback pace and potential impact on liquidity and earnings per share.
